headline: 839 hospitalised as dengue kills 5 more in 24 hours
summary: Total deaths rise to 82 and cases hit 28,929 as the virus continues to spread across Bangladesh.
details: At least five dengue patients died and 839 others were hospitalised in the 24 hours leading up to 8:00am today, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
Of the deaths, three were reported in Dhaka South City Corporation, and one each in Dhaka and Mymensingh divisions.
With these new figures, the total number of deaths from dengue has risen to 82, while total cases have reached 28,929.
Currently, 1,951 dengue patients are undergoing treatment at various hospitals across the country.

headline: 10 people shot in 16 days as gun violence grips Noakhali's Begumganj
summary: A wave of shootings across multiple unions has left residents in fear, with the latest attack targeting two high school students.
details: At least 10 people have been shot in a series of incidents over the past 16 days in Noakhali's Begumganj upazila. The attacks occurred across Alaiyarpur, Gopalpur, Choumuhani municipality and Ziratali union.
In the latest incident, masked gunmen opened fire and detonated crude bombs in the Banglabazar area of Ziratali union, injuring two class 10 students, Sakib Al Hasan and Shakawat Hossain Nadim.

Other recent shootings include an attack on five people traveling to a wedding on August 17, the abduction and shooting of an auto-rickshaw driver on August 12, and a shooting targeting a Jubo Dal leader on August 9.
On August 6, a bullet aimed at a former BNP secretary was instead fired into the abdomen of a pharmacy owner at the Choumuhani Hawkers Market.
Locals and political leaders from BNP and Jamaat have accused the police of failing to act, claiming armed groups are operating across nearly every union with little resistance.
Additional Superintendent of Police ANM Imran Khan stated that cases have been filed and raids have been conducted, but suspects often flee before they can be caught.
Police have recovered four foreign-made pistols and ammunition in recent months as drives to recover illegal firearms continue.
caption:
10 people shot in just 16 days. Gun violence is spiraling in Noakhali's Begumganj.

At least 10 people have been shot in a series of incidents over the past 16 days in Noakhali's Begumganj upazila. The attacks occurred across Alaiyarpur, Gopalpur, Choumuhani municipality and Ziratali union.

Other recent shootings include an attack on five people traveling to a wedding on August 17, the abduction and shooting of an auto-rickshaw driver on August 12, and a shooting targeting a Jubo Dal leader on August 9.

On August 6, a bullet aimed at a former BNP secretary was instead fired into the abdomen of a pharmacy owner at the Choumuhani Hawkers Market.

Locals and political leaders from BNP and Jamaat have accused the police of failing to act, claiming armed groups are operating across nearly every union with little resistance.

Additional Superintendent of Police ANM Imran Khan stated that cases have been filed and raids have been conducted, but suspects often flee before they can be caught.

Police have recovered four foreign-made pistols and ammunition in recent months as drives to recover illegal firearms continue.
